pages.text: The Borealis release owner is Mira Shah. The approved Borealis release budget is 12500 rupees. The launch date is 18 November 2026.
Borealis rollback is required if failed requests exceed two percent for ten minutes. The release checklist requires backup restoration before launch.
Customer support tickets are retained for 30 days. Security incidents must be escalated to the operations team within 20 minutes.
The Standard support plan promises an initial response within four business hours. The support contact is support@example.invalid.
Synapse runs the frontend on loopback port 3000 and FastAPI on loopback port 8000. The maximum document upload size is 20 MB. Scanned PDFs require OCR before import. CPU embeddings are supported.

Connected features are disabled by default. Local inference uses ONNX embeddings and Ollama. Integration credentials are stored in the OS credential store. Action approval expires after five minutes and can be used only once.
